stories.title: Markus Söder und Dominik Krause auf dem Oktoberfest: Fünf Loopings für Olympia-München

en.title: Markus Söder and Dominik Krause at Oktoberfest: Five loops for Olympic Munich
en.summary: Bavaria's CSU leader Söder and Munich's mayor Krause rode a roller coaster together at Oktoberfest, experiencing five loops at 90 kilometers per hour to support Munich's bid for the Olympic Games.

stories.title: USA: Donald Trump bestreitet Waffenangebot an China

en.title: USA: Donald Trump denies weapons offer to China
en.summary: A diplomat reportedly stated that Trump offered Chinese President Xi Jinping US weapons, but Trump denies this account, suggesting the matter concerned Taiwan instead.

stories.title: USA unter Trump: Trump dementiert Waffenangebot an China

en.title: USA under Trump: Trump denies weapons offer to China
en.summary: Trump refuted claims that he offered military weapons to China and reduced military exercises with South Korea in developments regarding US foreign policy.

stories.title: Ukraine: Auswärtiges Amt verurteilt russischen Angriff auf Nationale Akademie der Wissenschaften in Kyjiw

en.title: Ukraine: Foreign Office condemns Russian attack on National Academy of Sciences in Kyiv
en.summary: Russia attacked Ukraine's National Academy of Sciences in central Kyiv, killing at least one woman, while Russian forces also targeted the border region near Poland.

stories.title: „ZDF Magazin Royale“: Böhmermann: Ende war allein meine Entscheidung

en.title: "ZDF Magazin Royale": Böhmermann: The End Was My Decision Alone
en.summary: Jan Böhmermann discussed the conclusion of his show in a podcast with Olli Schulz, stating the decision was entirely his own. ZDF's director Norbert Himmler was reportedly surprised by the announcement.

stories.title: Elon Musk: Starship erreicht Orbit – SpaceX riskiert Abschied von Falcon 9

en.title: Elon Musk: Starship Reaches Orbit – SpaceX Risks Abandoning Falcon 9
en.summary: SpaceX's Starship achieved orbital flight for the first time, marking a significant milestone for the company's future plans. However, the rocket has yet to fulfill its most ambitious promises.

stories.title: Jan Böhmermann: Ende von »ZDF Magazin Royale« sei seine eigene Entscheidung gewesen

en.title: Jan Böhmermann: End of "ZDF Magazin Royale" Was His Own Decision
en.summary: Jan Böhmermann stated in the "Fest & Flauschig" podcast that he personally decided to end his show. He described the departure as painful.

stories.title: Olympia-Versprechen eingelöst: Ministerpräsident Söder wagt sich mit OB Krause in die Achterbahn

en.title: Olympic Promise Delivered: Minister President Söder Braves the Roller Coaster with Mayor Krause
en.summary: Despite being uncomfortable with thrill rides, CSU leader Söder rode a roller coaster with Munich's mayor to promote the city's Olympic bid. The two officials aim to boost international support for the candidacy.

stories.title: Russland stellt Metros Vermögenswerte unter Zwangsverwaltung

en.title: Russia places Metro's assets under state administration
en.summary: Metro AG continued operating its Russian business after the Ukraine war began. President Putin has now placed this division of the trading company under state administration, following similar actions against other businesses.

stories.title: Russland stellt deutschen Großhändler Metro unter Zwangsverwaltung

en.title: Russia places German wholesaler Metro under compulsory administration
en.summary: Metro, which remained in Russia after the invasion of Ukraine unlike many other international companies, has now lost its business operations in the country through forced state administration.

stories.title: Akademie der Wissenschaften in Kiew steht nach russischem Angriff in Flammen

en.title: National Academy of Sciences Building in Kyiv Engulfed in Flames Following Russian Attack
en.summary: A Russian military strike hit the historic building of Ukraine's National Academy of Sciences in Kyiv, causing a fire. At least one person was killed and rescue workers are searching for additional victims; other regions were also shelled.

stories.title: Newsblog zum Ukraine-Krieg: Nationale Akademie der Wissenschaften in Kiew in Flammen

en.title: News blog on Ukraine war: National Academy of Sciences in Kyiv engulfed in flames
en.summary: The historic building located near the German embassy was struck during a Russian attack on Kyiv. Video footage from Ukrainian President Zelensky documented the extent of the assault.

stories.title: KI: AMD kauft World Labs für rund acht Milliarden Dollar

en.title: AI: AMD buys World Labs for approximately eight billion dollars
en.summary: The chipmaker is expanding by acquiring a team of leading AI researchers and their models. The acquisition positions AMD to develop future hardware projects in artificial intelligence.

stories.title: Türkei: Überraschendes Treffen von Wüst und Erdogan in Ankara

en.title: Turkey: Surprising meeting between Wüst and Erdogan in Ankara
en.summary: Regional government leaders are typically not received by foreign heads of state. An exception occurred during a visit to Turkey by North Rhine-Westphalia's Minister President.

stories.title: Deep Read: Wie ein ganzes Kraftwerk von Deutschland in die Ukraine gebracht wird

en.title: Deep Read: How an entire power plant is being brought from Germany to Ukraine
en.summary: Germany is providing energy infrastructure support to Ukraine alongside military aid, involving tens of thousands of components in a major undertaking to help restore the country's power supply.

stories.title: Dow Jones, S&P 500, Nasdaq: Wall Street schließt niedriger

en.title: Dow Jones, S&P 500, Nasdaq: Wall Street closes lower
en.summary: Major U.S. stock indices declined as rising oil prices and increasing Treasury yields weighed on market sentiment, while investors awaited key economic events during the trading week.

stories.title: Landesbank: Verkauf geplatzt – Sparkassen wollen ihre Anteile an der NordLB vorerst behalten

en.title: Regional bank: Sale falls through – savings banks want to retain their stakes in NordLB for now
en.summary: Savings banks that helped rescue the regional bank NordLB in 2019 alongside Lower Saxony have decided not to sell their stakes at this time and want further discussions before any divestment.
